title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: LEON LOOKS UP
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Leon Pettibone, a retired train conductor from Minot, North Dakota.
Retired one month, he'd organized the garage three times. His wife Bernice hid the label maker.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE BOX
segments.quote: Astronomy compels the soul to look upwards and leads us from this world to another.
segments.author: Plato
lines: For his seventieth birthday, his granddaughter Maya mailed him a telescope.
Leon said, I've seen the sky.
But her card had a line from the Greek philosopher Plato:
Astronomy compels the soul to look upwards and leads us from this world to another.
Under it: Grandpa, show me Saturn at Christmas.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE DITCH
segments.quote: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
segments.author: Oscar Wilde
lines: Leon drove out a gravel road, away from town.
Nine degrees. He tripped into a snowy ditch.
He remembered an Oscar Wilde play Bernice once dragged him to:
We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
He quit grumbling and looked up until his eyebrows froze.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE SMUDGE
segments.quote: The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and science.
segments.author: Albert Einstein
lines: The manual read like a tax form, so Leon joined the astronomy club.
A retired dentist named Dot showed him a gray smudge. That's it? he said.
That's another galaxy, Dot said, and quoted Albert Einstein:
The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and science.
That light traveled two and a half million years. Leon looked again.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: COCOA NIGHTS
segments.quote: For my part I know nothing with any certainty, but the sight of the stars makes me dream.
segments.author: Vincent van Gogh
lines: Bernice thought he'd lost his mind. Then she noticed he was humming again.
Their kitchen calendar had a line from Vincent van Gogh:
For my part I know nothing with any certainty, but the sight of the stars makes me dream.
One night he wrapped her in blankets and showed her the Moon. Now Friday is cocoa and stars.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE CLOUDS
segments.quote: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
segments.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
lines: Christmas came. Maya came. So did the clouds, four nights in a row.
Leon paced like a late train. Maya showed him a line in The Little Prince:
It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
So he quit staring at the sky. They played cards and laughed till midnight.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE RINGS
segments.quote: Equipped with his five senses, man explores the universe around him and calls the adventure Science.
segments.author: Edwin Hubble
lines: On her last night, the clouds pulled apart.
Maya saw Saturn, rings and all, and yelled so loud the neighbor's dog howled.
Leon told her what the astronomer Edwin Hubble wrote:
Equipped with his five senses, man explores the universe around him and calls the adventure Science.
Now Leon runs free star nights at the old train depot.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Look up. Laugh in the ditch. Ask. Share. Love the cloudy nights. Keep exploring.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Look up. Laugh in the ditch. Ask. Share. Love the cloudy nights. Keep exploring.
I tried stargazing once. My bright star landed at the airport.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
